readme_sections.body:
Set `DATABASE_URL` to a PostgreSQL URL using the `postgresql+asyncpg://` driver.

Create a migration with `uv run alembic revision -m "describe change"`, edit its
`upgrade()` and `downgrade()` functions, then run `uv run alembic upgrade head`.
Review the revision before applying it. `uv run alembic upgrade head --sql`
prints SQL without connecting to a database.

For autogeneration, first replace the empty `target_metadata` in `migrations/env.py`
with your models' metadata and import all model modules; then use
`uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m "describe change"` against your database.
Do not autogenerate against an existing database with empty metadata.

Use `Depends(database_session, scope="function")` so transaction commit finishes
before the response is sent. Background tasks and streaming responses should
create their own short-lived sessions.
readme_sections.title: PostgreSQL
